topic: Financing a new car weeks before a mortgage application vs waiting until after closing (Marshall vs Kathleen)

scenes.narration: One new car loan can kill a mortgage approval. Today's patient checkup starts here.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named doctor dollar, dark curly hair, round gold-rim glasses, kind smile, white doctor coat over teal scrubs, golden stethoscope shaped like a dollar sign, holding a clipboard with a credit-score chart, doctor dollar in a bright clinic holding a clipboard showing a car crashing into a house with a stamp reading DENIED, comic burst banner reads WAIT UNTIL CLOSING, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Marshall and Kathleen both plan to buy a home this spring.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split clinic panel of man marshall and woman kathleen each holding a house listing, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Both are preapproved with a debt to income ratio of thirty six percent.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, two preapproval letters reading DTI THIRTY SIX PERCENT, a green check, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Marshall celebrates early with a new SUV, six hundred dollars a month.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man marshall driving a new SUV off a lot, a payment tag reads SIX HUNDRED MONTHLY, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: The lender reruns his credit before closing. New loan, new inquiry.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a lender at a screen showing a red alert reading NEW AUTO LOAN DETECTED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: His ratio jumps to forty five percent. The mortgage is denied.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a letter reading DTI FORTY FIVE PERCENT, MORTGAGE DENIED, man marshall beside his SUV, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: He loses the house, the rate lock, and his earnest money.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a house with a SOLD TO SOMEONE ELSE sign, a receipt reading EARNEST MONEY FORFEITED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Kathleen drives her old car and changes nothing until closing day.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman kathleen in an old hatchback with a sticky note reading NO NEW CREDIT UNTIL CLOSING, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: No new cards, no new loans, no big deposits without a paper trail.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a checklist reading NO NEW CARDS, NO NEW LOANS, DOCUMENT DEPOSITS, all checked, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Her ratio stays at thirty six percent. She closes on schedule.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman kathleen at a closing table receiving keys, a stamp reads CLOSED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: A month after closing she buys a modest used car in cash.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman kathleen beside a used sedan with a tag reading PAID CASH, her new house behind her, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: No new credit between preapproval and closing. None. See you next visit. Stay financially healthy!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named doctor dollar, dark curly hair, round gold-rim glasses, kind smile, white doctor coat over teal scrubs, golden stethoscope shaped like a dollar sign, holding a clipboard with a credit-score chart, doctor dollar in a bright clinic holding a clipboard reading NO NEW CREDIT UNTIL CLOSING, a healthy DTI chart behind her, kids comic book illustration
